crossRefs.note: She is loud and defiant. Her feet don’t stay in her house.
It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop than to share a house with a contentious woman.
It is better to dwell in a desert land, than with a contentious and fretful woman.
he is conceited, knowing nothing, but obsessed with arguments, disputes, and word battles, from which come envy…

translations.web: The foolish woman is loud, undisciplined, and knows nothing.
translations.bsb: The woman named Folly is loud; she is naive and knows nothing.
translations.kjv: A foolish woman is clamorous: she is simple, and knoweth nothing.
translations.asv: The foolish woman is clamorous; She is simple, and knoweth nothing.
